svg.title: Black Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and vivid screen colors. Individual Chicago component actually viewed in the museum public image preview and downloaded through the ordinary browser. Major corner/curve positions transcribed; wall and cast shadow omitted. Overall bounding aspect uses museum dimensions. Individual panels are distinct from the installation group.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/152752; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
